text: Big data is often not the output of instruments designed to generate valid and reliable data suitable for scientific analysis, so foundational data quality problems persist regardless of how much data is collected.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization - Past, Present, and Future (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411897
abstract: Big data is often not the output of instruments designed to generate valid and reliable data suitable for scientific analysis.
